title: Father's Day
overview: On the verge of fatherhood, Sushant learns his estranged father is alive. Hoping to reconnect, he sets out on a one-day motorcycle ride through rural Karnataka to meet the man who once abandoned him. What follows is a journey of discovery, bonding, and unforgettable moments, an emotional ride that comes once in a lifetime.
